Email.Subject: You're invired to try the Carton Caps app!
Email.Body:
Hi! [referrerName] here. 

 Join me in earning cash for our school by using the Carton Caps app. It's an easy way to make a difference. All you have to do is buy Carton Caps participating products (like Cheerios!) and scan your grocery receipt. Carton Caps are worth $10 each and they add up fast. Twice a year, our school receivesa check to help pay for whatever we need - equipment, supplies or experiences the kids love! 

 Download the Carton Caps app here [deeplink]
